## Games

### Bamberg Baskets Fall to Bonn in 71:85 Thriller

*Played Saturday, 14 November 2026* *(updated with new sources)*

The BMA365 Bamberg Baskets suffered a 71:85 defeat at the hands of the Telekom Baskets Bonn in their 9th league match. Despite a strong performance from Bamberg, who led the game at various points, they ultimately fell to Bonn's strong finish. Bamberg's Trevon Scott led the team with 14 points, while Jordan Jones, Richard Balint, and Hason Ward each contributed 10 points. Bonn, meanwhile, had six players score in double digits, with Marcus Foster leading the way with 13 points. The loss drops Bamberg to 11th place in the standings, while Bonn extends their winning streak to three games. The Baskets will look to bounce back in their next match, which is set to take place in the Basketball Champions League on November 17th.

### Ratiopharm Ulm dominate Science City Jena 97:78

*Played Saturday, 14 November 2026*

Ratiopharm Ulm secured a convincing 97:78 win over Science City Jena in a game that was not expected to be of high quality. However, both teams showed some flashes of brilliance, but also a lot of struggles. Ulm took an early lead, 15:0, after just three minutes, and never looked back. They led 33:11 after the first quarter and 50:39 at halftime. Jena managed to halve the deficit in the second quarter, but Ulm regained their momentum in the third quarter, with Devin Schmidt, Jaylen Sims, and Michael Rataj hitting crucial three-pointers. The visitors were unable to mount a comeback in the final quarter, and Ulm cruised to the win. Filip Stanic, Ulm's new signing, was unable to make a significant impact in his first game.

### ALBA Berlin cruises to 95-77 win over EWE Baskets Oldenburg

*Played Saturday, 14 November 2026*

ALBA Berlin secured their first away win of the season with a 95-77 victory over EWE Baskets Oldenburg on November 14. The Berliners dominated the game, particularly in the second half, with Jordan Ford scoring 17 points, Brandon Angel and Joe Wieskamp each contributing 15 points, and Martin Hermannsson adding 14 points, including a perfect 4/4 from three-point range. ALBA's coach Pedro Calles praised the team's defensive effort in the first 30 minutes but acknowledged that they need to improve over the full 40 minutes. Oldenburg's coach Milenko Bogicevic conceded that his team was outplayed, particularly in the first half, and vowed to learn from the loss and improve for the next game.

### Nigel Pruitt joins Rostock Seawolves Academy in ProB Nord

*Played Sunday, 15 November 2026*

The Rostock Seawolves Academy has strengthened its team in the BARMER 2. Basketball Bundesliga ProB Nord with the signing of Nigel Pruitt. The 32-year-old American, who was born in Knoxville, Tennessee, will wear the number 7 jersey for the Norddeutsche team. Pruitt's experience is expected to help the young team, particularly on the wing position in the rotation. He will also support the development of the team's young players. Pruitt had 10 points in his first game for Rostock, playing nearly 24 minutes against Schwelm. He has a long history in German basketball, having played for several teams including SBB Baskets Wolmirstedt, Keflavík ÍF, and SC Rasta Vechta. Pruitt's average statistics for the 2025-2026 season were 8.5 points, 2.2 rebounds, and 44.3% 3FG in 18 games.

## Around the League

### Bamberg Baskets Offer Easter Camp for Kids

The Bamberg Baskets, the reigning German Cup winners and nine-time German Basketball champions, are hosting an Easter camp for kids aged 7-14 from March 22-25, 2027. The camp is a collaboration between Stadtwerke Bamberg, the BMA365 Bamberg Baskets, and Freak City Bamberg e.V. The camp offers a variety of activities, including basketball training led by professional youth coaches, as well as workshops and excursions. According to Niklas Rajczyk, the camp's coordinator, the program is not just about basketball, but also includes other fun activities. Parents can register their children online now, with 100 spots available. Registration is recommended as the spots are expected to fill up quickly.

Sources:

- [Bamberg Baskets: Jetzt schon fürs kommende Basketball-Ostercamp anmelden | Bamberg Baskets](https://www.bamberg.basketball/news/jetzt-schon-fuers-kommende-basketball-ostercamp-anmelden)
